Name: Custom Text Signs
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
[size=5][u][b]Overview[/b][/u][/size]

This mod enables an item context tag to designate any big craftable as a text sign.

By default, it adds this context tag to wood signs, stone signs, and dark signs.


[size=5][u][b]Basic Usage[/b][/u][/size]

To add text to a sign, interact with it as you normally would.

To trigger vanilla interactions with objects designated as text signs, hold down the suppress hotkey (default [b]Left Shift[/b]) while trying to interact with the object.

To adjust the vertical position of the text bubble, hover over the object's base tile and hold down the up or down hotkey (default [b]NumPad 8 [/b]and [b]NumPad 2[/b]).

To adjust the max width of the text bubble, hover over the object's base tile and hold down the increase or decrease width hotkey (default [b]NumPad 4 [/b]and [b]NumPad 6[/b]).


[size=5][u][b]Advanced Usage[/b][/u][/size]

To designate any object type as a text sign, use Content Patcher to add the context tag "text_sign" to the object. An example of how to set context tags is here:

[url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/blob/stable/ContentPatcher/docs/author-guide/action-editdata.md#target-field]https://github.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/blob/stable/ContentPatcher/docs/author-guide/action-editdata.md#target-field[/url]


[size=5][u][b]Config[/b][/u][/size]

The config has entries for the hotkeys and max text length. There is also an option to remove the context tag from ordinary signs.

Use GMCM to set config variables.


[size=5][u][b]Technical[/b][/u][/size]

Requires SMAPI.

Implements a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] interface to change config settings in-game.

Translations should use config variable names as the keys, adding .Desc to the end of the key for hover descriptions.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].

A list of all my mods for Stardew Valley is available at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895[/url].
